pose_guides.basis: Authored native jaw arc guided by visible mouth opening; not a measured 3D joint angle.

source_video.prompt: Animate exactly this stylized wolf performing ONE forward lunging bite attack, then recovering to its original standing stance. Keep its four-leg anatomy, exact fur, collar pieces, colors, proportions and centered hanging tail. Fixed orthographic side camera, facing LEFT, entire wolf visible with generous room around the head, paws and tail; no camera motion, zoom, cuts or turns. Start still, briefly crouch with rear paws braced, drive the shoulders and head forward in one sharp bite strike, place the front paws securely, then recover and stand still. Preserve the original mouth construction and teeth. Readable anticipation, one peak bite/contact moment, short recovery; no repeated attacks, running or continuing forward travel. Natural backward foreleg elbow bend and downward airborne paws. Tail follows the body coherently with subtle tip motion. Plain neutral gray background, even lighting, fixed ground line. No opponent, weapon, props, blood, particles, scenery, text or new limbs.

fore_left.basis: Reviewed visible flight-paw locations regularized to native reach; single-view hidden depth held to native geometry.

fore_right.basis: Reviewed visible flight-paw locations regularized to native reach; single-view hidden depth held to native geometry.

hind_left.basis: Rear step and airborne extension; native reach and heel/toe surface constraints take priority over generated stretching.

hind_right.basis: Rear step and airborne extension; native reach and heel/toe surface constraints take priority over generated stretching.

body_roll_policy: Toward-camera native roll with optional lateral limb tuck and head counter-roll; single-side lateral detail authored.

post_processing.interpolation: Nonperiodic PCHIP, contact refinement at stored timestamps; exported local transforms use linear translation and quaternion interpolation.

trajectory_provenance: Evaluated fitted native skin; these are motion-library trajectories, not independently video-measured hidden joints.
